metadata.description: Claude Code / Cowork plugin for editing in DaVinci Resolve Studio 21+

plugins.name: davinci-editor
plugins.description: Video editing in DaVinci Resolve Studio 21+ via the DaVinci Resolve MCP server: color (log, chart, skin, depth blur), transcription, text-based rough cut, screen + camera PiP, sound design, loudness finish, motion graphics, zooms, subtitles, Shorts, chapters, thumbnails, QC and delivery, markers, track layout.
